This build uses off the shelf components in the manner they were designed. It is a violation of the Computer Fraud & Abuse Act, and using encryption over radio violates FCC regulations.

900Mhz is regulated under fcc part 15 (like 2.4Ghz and 5.8Ghz) and encryption is totally legal in this band as long as you abide by part 15 regulations.

That being said this setup is patently stupid. Omni-directional antennas that size in 900mhz will get you at most a mile of poor quality connection. And a directional antenna would pinpoint your location defeating its anonymity. To be honest the 802.11n based OFDM system employed by Ubiquiti is just plain stupid in the interference riddled 900Mhz spectrum. What you really want is a 802.15 variant frequency hopping system (like Bluetooth or zigbee) to increase noise immunity and make tracking the equipment down even harder.
